name: ccx
description: ccx: continue the same task in Claude, Codex, Antigravity and ZCode. Needs the ccx app on this Mac: github.com/aaronwong1999/ccx

interface.longDescription: Continue a task from Claude, Antigravity or ZCode in Codex, or hand it back, with synchronized progress. Everything runs through your local ccx app. Not affiliated with OpenAI, Anthropic, Google or Z.ai.
